title: Hearth thermostat/v1 set_range parameters
description: Set the paired heating (low) and cooling (high) targets. Send both, even in heat or cool mode. Does not change the mode.

low.description: Heating target in integer milli-Celsius, such as 20000 for 20 °C.

high.description: Cooling target in integer milli-Celsius, such as 24000 for 24 °C.
